india_trends.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
india_trends.summary: Indian equities extended losses, with Sensex falling 281 points and Nifty declining for a fifth session. Analysts flagged crude prices, Strait of Hormuz tensions and Fed minutes as key drivers. Broader markets gained, while market breadth remained bearish with more declines than advances.

india_trends.title: Jio vs Airtel: the base plan is now the new telecom battleground
india_trends.summary: The move from Reliance Jio, whose tariffs already trade at a discount to peers, could affect Airtel’s strategy to upgrade base-level plan users to higher tariffs. The pricing divergence also puts the spotlight on Vodafone Idea.

india_trends.title: Who is Sam Mehta? L3Harris names replacement for ousted CEO Christopher Kubasik
india_trends.summary: Incoming CEO Sam Mehta, 53, joined L3Harris in 2023. He had led L3Harris's Space &amp; Mission Systems and Communications &amp; Spectrum Dominance segments, which together account for about 80% of total revenue.

india_trends.title: ICICI Bank raises $750 million as Indian banks tap dollar bond market

india_trends.title: FCNR(B) swap cost unlikely to have driven RBI’s early closure: SBI Research report
india_trends.summary: SBI Research said the cost of the RBI’s FCNR(B) swap facility is unlikely to have driven its early closure, estimating cumulative hedging costs at USD 10.5 billion over five years.
